metadata.bug: A start held during DONE bypasses the IDLE state and immediately launches another computation.
metadata.trigger: Keep start high through the cycle in which current_state is DONE. At the next clock edge the mutant enters COMPUTE directly; the original enters IDLE and does not enter COMPUTE until a later edge.
metadata.effect: A continuously asserted start causes transactions to restart sooner than the original protocol allows, changing the timing of done and ciphertext updates.
